description: This bar chart illustrates the performance gain for different large vision-language models (LVLMs) under varying levels of supervision. The horizontal axis represents the LVLM, with categories labeled “GPT-4o”, “Claude-3.5-Sonnet”, and “Qwen-72B-VL”, presented in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Performance Gain (%)”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 5. Two bars are present for each LVLM, representing “Strong Supervision” in a darker purple hue and “Weak Supervision” in a lighter purple hue. For GPT-4o, the “Strong Supervision” bar extends to approximately 28% while the “Weak Supervision” bar reaches about 12%. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the “Strong Supervision” bar reaches approximately 10% and the “Weak Supervision” bar extends to about 4%. Finally, for Qwen-72B-VL, the “Strong Supervision” bar reaches approximately 16% and the “Weak Supervision” bar extends to about 8%. The bars are grouped, with the “Strong Supervision” and “Weak Supervision” bars positioned adjacent to each other for each LVLM, allowing for a visual comparison within each model. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
